help_support.title: Help & Support
help_support.vendor_intro: Guides for managing your products, fulfilling orders, and running your stall - plus direct access to the PalengkeHub support team.
help_support.customer_intro: Get answers about ordering, payments, pickups and refunds - or reach the PalengkeHub support team directly.
help_support.vendor_faq_q1: How do I add or update products?
help_support.vendor_faq_a1: Open the Products tab and tap Add Product. Set your name, price, stock and photo. Edits go live for customers instantly.
help_support.vendor_faq_q2: How do I manage incoming orders?
help_support.vendor_faq_a2: The Orders tab shows new orders first. Tap an order to Confirm it, mark it Preparing while packing, then Ready when the customer can pick up.
help_support.vendor_faq_q3: When do customers pick up orders?
help_support.vendor_faq_a3: Customers see your stall location and pickup instructions in their Pickup Pass. Have the order packed and marked Ready before they arrive.
help_support.vendor_faq_q4: Why is my product not showing to customers?
help_support.vendor_faq_a4: Check that stock is greater than zero and the product is toggled available. Products with zero stock are hidden automatically.
help_support.vendor_faq_q5: How do I see my sales performance?
help_support.vendor_faq_a5: The Reports tab shows daily sales, top products and order trends so you can track what sells best.
help_support.vendor_faq_q6: What are my responsibilities as a vendor?
help_support.vendor_faq_a6: Keep prices accurate, maintain fresh stock, confirm orders promptly, and honor approved refunds. See Privacy & Policy for your full rights and duties.
help_support.customer_faq_q1: How do I place an order?
help_support.customer_faq_a1: Open the Home tab, pick a stall or product, add items to your cart, then tap Checkout. Once the vendor confirms, you will receive a Pickup Pass with your pickup details.
help_support.customer_faq_q2: How do I track my order?
help_support.customer_faq_a2: Go to the Orders tab to follow live updates: Ordered > Confirmed > Preparing > Ready for pickup > Completed. Push notifications are sent at every step.
help_support.customer_faq_q3: What payment methods can I use?
help_support.customer_faq_a3: Depending on what you selected at checkout, you can pay via GCash or in cash when you pick up your order at the market.
help_support.customer_faq_q4: Where do I pick up my order?
help_support.customer_faq_a4: Each stall lists its exact location inside Lipa City Public Market. Your Pickup Pass shows the stall number plus a map so you can find it easily.
help_support.customer_faq_q5: How do I change my language?
help_support.customer_faq_a5: Go to Profile > Language and choose English or Filipino. The app defaults to English.
help_support.customer_faq_a6: Yes. We only collect what is needed to run your orders and we never sell your data. See Privacy & Policy in your Profile for the full details.
help_support.vendor_guide_1_s1: Verify stock is above zero and availability is ON.
help_support.vendor_guide_1_s2: Make sure the product name is spelled clearly for search.
help_support.vendor_guide_1_s3: Re-open the product and re-save if changes did not publish.
help_support.vendor_guide_2_s1: Refresh the Orders tab - statuses sync in real time.
help_support.vendor_guide_2_s2: Check your internet connection and pull down to refresh.
help_support.vendor_guide_2_s3: If it persists, report it via Report an Issue in your Profile.
help_support.vendor_guide_3_s1: Reports only count completed orders - cancelled ones are excluded.
help_support.vendor_guide_3_s2: Pull to refresh to reload the latest figures.
help_support.customer_guide_1_s1: Open the order in your Orders tab.
help_support.customer_guide_1_s2: Message the vendor first via Chat - most issues are fixed right away.
help_support.customer_guide_1_s3: If unresolved, tap Report an Issue to file a report with market admins.
help_support.customer_guide_2_s1: Refunds cover paid-but-unfulfilled orders and verified item complaints.
help_support.customer_guide_2_s2: File within 24 hours of pickup through Report an Issue.
help_support.customer_guide_2_s3: Approved GCash refunds are processed within 3-5 business days; cash refunds at the stall.
help_support.customer_guide_3_s1: Vendors confirm orders manually - allow up to 30 minutes.
help_support.customer_guide_3_s2: Still nothing? Message the vendor in Chat or contact support below.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy & Policy
privacy_policy.customer_intro: PalengkeHub is committed to protecting your personal information. This policy explains what we collect, why we collect it, and what rights you have when using our marketplace.
privacy_policy.data_protection_p1: We collect only the information needed to complete your orders: your name, contact details, delivery/pickup preference, payment confirmation, and order history.
privacy_policy.data_protection_p2: We never sell or rent your personal data to third parties. Vendors only receive the minimum information required to fulfill your order (e.g. stall pickup instructions).
privacy_policy.data_protection_p3: You can withdraw consent at any time. Opt out of marketing notifications in Profile > Notifications, or request full data deletion by contacting support.
privacy_policy.data_protection_p4: All personal data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and stored securely. Sensitive fields such as payment tokens are tokenized and never stored on our servers.
privacy_policy.rights_p1: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time.
privacy_policy.rights_p2: You may request a portable copy of your data (name, orders, preferences) by emailing support@palengkehub.com.
privacy_policy.rights_p3: You are responsible for keeping your account details accurate and your device secure. Report suspicious activity immediately.
privacy_policy.rights_p4: You may close your account at any time. Order history is retained for compliance for up to 24 months as required by PH tax law.
privacy_policy.refunds_p1: Refunds are processed for paid-but-unfulfilled orders and verified item complaints reported within 24 hours of pickup.
privacy_policy.refunds_p2: To request a refund: open the order in Orders > Report an Issue, attach a photo if relevant, and submit. Our team reviews within 1 business day.
privacy_policy.refunds_p3: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method - GCash credits typically arrive within 3-5 business days; cash refunds are issued at the stall.
privacy_policy.refunds_p4: Returns are accepted for wrong or damaged items only. The stall must be given the chance to resolve the issue on the spot before escalation.
privacy_policy.refunds_p5: Refunds for marketplace-level errors (wrong billing, duplicate charge) are processed with priority.
privacy_policy.vendor_intro: As a PalengkeHub vendor, this policy explains what stall and business data we collect, how it is used to connect you with customers, and your rights and compliance obligations under Philippine law.
privacy_policy.vendor_data_p1: We collect the information you provide in your vendor application and stall profile: business name, stall number/section, valid ID, bank or GCash payout details, contact information, product listings, and order history.
privacy_policy.vendor_data_p2: Your stall data is shown to customers so they can find and order from you. We never publish your personal ID images or payout details to shoppers.
privacy_policy.vendor_data_p3: Order data (items, totals, pickup time) is shared with the customer placing the order and with market admins for reconciliation and analytics.
privacy_policy.vendor_data_p4: Aggregate analytics (sales, peak times, popular items) are shown in your Reports tab. You may opt out of aggregated benchmark emails at any time.
privacy_policy.vendor_rights_p1: You retain ownership of your product and stall data; you may edit or remove your listings at any time through the Products screen.
privacy_policy.vendor_rights_p2: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your account data. Contact support for a full data export.
privacy_policy.vendor_rights_p3: You are responsible for keeping prices accurate, maintaining fresh stock, confirming orders promptly, and honoring approved refunds.
privacy_policy.vendor_rights_p4: You must comply with the Lipa City Public Market stall rules and the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012. Misuse of customer data (e.g. contacting buyers outside the platform for unrelated sales) will result in account suspension.
privacy_policy.vendor_compliance_title: Compliance with Local Regulations & Marketplace Standards
privacy_policy.vendor_compliance_p1: All vendors must be registered with the Lipa City Public Market and hold valid permits (Mayors permit, FDA/BFAD where applicable). PalengkeHub may request these during application review.
privacy_policy.vendor_compliance_p2: We retain transaction and communication records for up to 24 months to comply with PH tax and Data Privacy Act requirements.
privacy_policy.vendor_compliance_p3: Marketplace standards require: truthful product listings, accurate pricing, timely order fulfillment, and respectful handling of customer reports/refunds.
privacy_policy.vendor_compliance_p4: Repeated policy violations may lead to temporary suspension or permanent removal from the platform.
